decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The details of the hard and soft landscaping as shown on submitted drawing numbers 2515/15 received 17/08/05 are acceptable in showing that the site would be satisfactory landscaped and the Council is satisfied that the appearance and character of the site or wider area would be maintained in line with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and C.1.2 (New Religious Meeting Places) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for erection of two storey Hindu Centre, incorporating Hindu temple and two storey annexe building, linked by two storey covered walkway, with ancillary car parking details submitted pursuant to Condition 22 (hard and soft landscaping) of planning permission reference 01501/A/P2 approved 16/12/1999.
